title: Cerebus Mothers & Daughters #159 June, Dave Sim - Aardvark-Vanaheim
descriptionText: This is a first edition comic book titled "Cerebus Mothers & Daughters June #159" written and illustrated by Dave Sim for Aardvark-Vanaheim. The comic belongs to the Cerebus series, a Canadian alternative and underground comic book that was published in the 1990s. The comic features the character Mother, a central figure in the series, and is part of the Modern era of comic book tradition. It is a must-have for collectors of US Comics and fans of the Cerebus series.
